caveats: This is the newly adopted independent two-cylinder tripod design. All16 selected images were generated for this branch. Legacy root normal/pixel and original metadata are retained unchanged and were not image references for the new design.

New anatomy: two equal-diameter low cylinders stacked vertically, connected by one short thick central column; two eyes only on the upper front curved wall; one flat vertically elongated purple scale only on the lower front wall; three equal short legs in a triangular attachment plan. No arms, wings or tail. The legacy seed-shaped body and leaf wings are not identity requirements of this version.

S normalv2 defines the accepted new front identity and a front-left/front-right/rear-center tripod production coordinate. Eye pair, lower front marker and tripod positions are assessed as turning together in representative views. Front views show two eyes and one marker; side views show an edge eye and edge marker; back views show neither.

Exact45-degree spacing, measured rigid3D rotation, hidden leg-root geometry and equal projected leg lengths are not proven. NE/NW feet are not exact mirror projections. Top-plane exposure, body-to-leg proportions and texture phase vary modestly among generated views.

Each selected pixel image was generated with its corresponding selected normal as the sole image reference. Pixel rendering strengthens contrast, yellow/beige tones and scale boundaries, simplifies scalloped scales toward diamond-like steps, and can slightly narrow overall proportions.

Palette roles are sandy beige cylinders(#C9BB8F), pale periwinkle connector and legs(#BAC8E8), muted gray-purple front marker and edges(#625C7F), with generated shading rather than exact flat color patches.

Snormalv1 with an overlapping-looking marker,SEnormalv1 with insufficient leg rotation,andNEpixelv1 with unwanted front features were retained privately as unselected quality-review outputs. The selected replacements are Snormalv2,SEnormalv2,andNEpixelv2. There were19 successful image returns for16 selected assets, with no safety refusal in this new branch.
Game integration, runtime animation and device-scale appearance have not been tested.
